name: Simmons Animal Nutrition
old_description: is the leading North American private-label and contract manufacturer of wet pet food.
about:
Simmons Animal Nutrition operates as a division of Simmons Foods, a family-owned business founded in 1949 in Siloam Springs, Arkansas. The company traces its roots to the Simmons family, who have maintained ownership and leadership for over 75 years, emphasizing a 'small company mindset' despite significant growth.

Today, Simmons Animal Nutrition focuses on private-label and contract manufacturing of wet pet food, producing store-brand products for retailers across North America. Through its affiliate Simmons Pet Food, it is the largest supplier of store-brand wet pet food on the continent. The division also develops proprietary animal nutrition formulations for pet food, animal feed, and aquaculture markets. With more than 9,500 team members across the Simmons Foods affiliate network, the operation serves customers in all 50 U.S. states and over 40 countries.

The company's customer base includes retail chains seeking private-label wet pet food, as well as brands in the pet food, animal feed, and aquaculture sectors. Simmons Prepared Foods, another affiliate, ranks among the top 15 U.S. poultry producers, supplying chicken products to restaurants and retailers worldwide. This integrated structure allows Simmons Animal Nutrition to leverage poultry supply chains for its pet food and nutrition lines.

Leadership attributes the company's differentiation to its private, family-owned structure, which enables 'creativity before capital' and a long-term perspective. CEO Todd Simmons has stated that the organization strives to retain a small-company mindset while pursuing continuous improvement, driven by the belief that there is always a better way.

name: Sinclair Manufacturing Co
old_description: PacAero Norton, formally Sinclair manufactures hermetic packages for microelectronic, fiber-optic, microwave, and optical applications. They specialize in high-quality, custom machined or stamped packages with glass seals.
about:
PacAero Norton, formerly known as Sinclair Manufacturing Co, operates from Norton, Massachusetts. The business traces its roots to the original Sinclair Manufacturing Co, which was rebranded as PacAero Norton to reflect its focus on advanced hermetic packaging.

The facility specializes in hermetic packages for microelectronic, fiber-optic, microwave, and optical applications. Core processes include precision machining of Kovar, copper‑molybdenum, titanium, and aluminum; glass‑to‑metal sealing; high‑volume production of RF and DC feedthroughs; feedthrough integration and brazing; and turnkey sapphire window assemblies. In‑house testing follows MIL‑STD and JEDEC standards. Key product lines encompass optical windows, fiber‑optic packages, microwave packages, high‑thermal‑dissipation power packages, hybrid packages, vacuum products, and headers/connectors.

Customers span the microelectronics, fiber‑optics, microwave, and optical industries, with the company serving original equipment manufacturers and subsystem integrators in those sectors.

PacAero Norton emphasizes its specialization in high‑quality, custom machined or stamped packages with glass seals, offering turnkey assembly and qualified testing as a combined capability.

name: Sinco Inc
about:
Founded in 1996 in Conway, Arkansas, Sinco Inc. operates as a contract metal manufacturer serving a diverse range of end markets. The company does not publicly disclose its founders or ownership structure beyond being a privately held entity.

Sinco provides sheet metal fabrication services including laser profiling, brake press forming, MIG/TIG/spot and aluminum spool welding, CNC milling and tube cutting, powder coating on two conveyor lines, and assembly. The 115,000-square-foot facility employs over 75 people and runs an electronic Kanban system for just-in-time inventory management and same-day delivery.

The company serves industries such as automotive machinery, supply chain equipment, irrigation infrastructure, industrial machinery, consumer retail, and hospitality. Customers include OEMs and contract manufacturers requiring precision metal parts and finished assemblies.

Sinco differentiates itself through ISO 9001:2015 certification, Six Sigma and Toyota Kata continuous improvement practices, weekly performance metric reviews, and Certified Welding Inspectors on staff. An expedited 'Hot' job process accommodates urgent deadlines, while a dedicated supply chain team works to maintain competitive pricing.

name: Sioux Manufacturing Corporation
old_description: Sioux Manufacturing Corporation is a Native American owned business operating out of a 250,000 sq. ft. facility located on the Spirit Lake Nation in Fort Totten, North Dakota.
about:
Sioux Manufacturing Corporation was founded in 1976 in Fort Totten, North Dakota, on the Spirit Lake Nation. The company is a Native American‑owned business operating from a 250,000‑square‑foot facility.

The company produces composite molded components for defense applications. Its capabilities span prepreg cutting with Lectra Vector 2500 vertical knife cutters and slitter sheeters, compression molding on hydraulic presses ranging from 200 to 1,500 tons, autoclave molding up to 175 psi and 500 °F, and CNC machining via four abrasive waterjet centers and five 3‑axis machining centers. Finishing services include bonding, hardware installation, priming, painting, and final assembly in two paint booths and a grit‑blast booth. Quality assurance covers receiving, in‑process, and final inspection using an Instron dual‑column test system, a Hexagon Global CMM, a FaroArm 3D measuring arm, and an on‑site ballistics range.

Sioux Manufacturing’s primary customer is the U.S. Department of Defense, to which it has supplied quality products for over 50 years. The company’s output supports defense programs requiring composite structures and assemblies.

The firm emphasizes continuous quality improvement, cost control, and on‑time delivery as the foundation of its customer satisfaction philosophy. Its hiring strategy focuses on retaining skilled personnel to maintain technical expertise and regional economic contribution.

name: SisTech Manufacturing
old_description: Your Partner for High-Reliability PCB Assembly and Electronic Manufacturing
about:
SisTech Manufacturing operates from a purpose-built facility in Bend, Oregon. The company was founded by industry veterans with deep experience in electronics manufacturing, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. The leadership team includes CEO Brad Kennedy, formerly VP of Operations at Vadatech Inc. and General Manager at GE Fanuc Embedded Systems Group; Operations lead Tyler Eggleston, with background at Raytheon and Collins Aerospace; and Supply Chain manager Mike Greer, a 30-year veteran of Arrow Electronics.

SisTech provides contract electronic manufacturing and mechanical assembly services, specializing in turnkey and kitted printed circuit board assemblies from quick-turn prototypes to high-volume production. Its capabilities include surface-mount placement down to 01005 components, BGA/microBGA/LGA/CSP/PoP assembly, selective soldering, in-house conformal coating, and a full suite of testing — automated optical inspection (2D/3D), X-ray with CT scan, functional and in-circuit test. The Bend facility houses six Europlacer SMT lines, Mirtec AOI, Nordson DAGE X-ray, ERSA and Aqueous Tech equipment. The company also offers design-for-manufacturing feedback, PCB layout support, obsolescence management, box-build integration, and a counterfeit-parts prevention program.

The company serves high-technology customers in defense, aerospace, energy, embedded electronics, and consumer electronics across the Pacific Northwest and nationally. It targets partners with mid- to high-range production volumes, defined production roadmaps, and requirements for rigorous quality, documentation, and traceability — explicitly avoiding one-off prototypes with no production intent and ultra-high-volume commodity builds.

SisTech differentiates itself through a lifetime manufacturing warranty, proactive DFM engagement, and a partnership model that includes early component procurement against customer forecasts. Its quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015, ITAR registered, and CMMC Level 1, with staff certified to IPC-A-610 and IPC-7711/7721. The leadership team’s collective 130-plus years of experience underpins a focus on complex, high-reliability assemblies and long-term supply-chain stability.

name: Six Six Apparel
old_description: Six Six Apparel’s services include custom screen printing, dye sublimation printing, DTF printing and embroidery.
about:
Six Six Apparel operates from Brownsburg, Indiana, just west of Indianapolis. The business began in 2006 as a home-based screen printing shop run out of a garage, where screens were washed at a local carwash. After moving through several garage spaces, the company settled into its current facility in 2017.

The shop provides custom screen printing, dye sublimation printing, direct-to-film (DTF) printing, embroidery, graphic design, and cut-and-sew manufacturing. It produces over 200,000 screen printed shirts annually and runs a cut-and-sew team that assembles dye-sublimated garments with edge-to-edge graphics. The facility handles all-over sublimation on performance fabrics such as dry-fit, moisture-wicking, and UV-protective materials, and uses eco-friendly inks with Pantone color matching.

Customers span athletic activewear, hospitality, motorsports, and corporate apparel. The company has produced dye-sublimated jerseys, uniforms, and hoodies for racing teams, bowling leagues, professional fishing apparel, clay shooting teams, and archery leagues. It also supplies embroidered corporate wear—polos, jackets, hats, bags, and luggage—and prints banners, flags, and table covers for hospitality events.

The founder cites a Kaizen philosophy of continuous improvement, emphasizing clean equipment, triple-checked order accuracy, and reliable service. Eco-friendly inks and made-in-USA cut-and-sew production are highlighted as core differentiators.

name: Sixto Packaging
old_description: The company was founded by Felipe and Carmen Sixto and their three sons, Felipe, Emilio, and Andres. Today, the company includes three generations of the Sixto family in its daily operations.
about:
Sixto Packaging is based in Opa-locka, Florida. The company was founded by Felipe and Carmen Sixto along with their three sons, Felipe, Emilio, and Andres, and today operates with three generations of the family involved in daily operations. It is a family-owned and minority-certified flexible packaging converter.

The company prints, laminates, and converts flexible packaging into pouches, bags, and shrink sleeves entirely in-house. Its capabilities also include graphics engineering services to support design and prepress needs. All production steps are kept under one roof, allowing control over quality and turnaround.

Sixto Packaging serves the snack food, coffee, beverage, medical, personal care, household, and pet food markets, among other specialty sectors. Customers range from consumer brands to industrial packagers seeking custom flexible packaging solutions.

The company emphasizes quick lead times, a commitment it has maintained for over 40 years, and positions itself as an advocate for flexible packaging, having been featured in industry publications such as Flexible Packaging Magazine.

name: Skeels Electric Co
old_description: Founded in 1914, Skeels Electric Company in Bismarck North Dakota
about:
Founded in 1914 in Bismarck, North Dakota, Skeels Electric Company is a multigenerational, family-owned electrical contractor that has served the region for over a century.

The company provides commercial, industrial, residential, and communications wiring services, along with electrical panel upgrades and energy and lighting audits. Its work spans new construction, renovations, and maintenance for institutional, commercial, and industrial facilities as well as private homes.

Skeels Electric serves a broad customer base that includes commercial property owners, institutional campuses, industrial plants, and residential clients across North Dakota. Projects range from office buildings and schools to manufacturing facilities and single-family homes, with communications infrastructure such as data and voice wiring also in scope.

According to the company, its differentiation rests on a focus on customer service, the use of high-quality products, employment of trained professionals, and maintenance of safe work environments. These practices are intended to ensure that jobs are completed on time and on budget, with a commitment to exceeding expectations from concept through design, construction, completion, and post-project support.

name: Sky's Offroad Design & Sky Manufacturing
old_description: These springs boast a 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finish in The Ultra4 4600 Class against 4-links and V8 power.  We have continually tweaked these to perfection through rigorous miles of trail and desert racing since 2004!
about:
Sky's Offroad Design & Sky Manufacturing operates from Springfield, Oregon. The company traces its roots to 2004, when founder Sky began developing and racing suspension components in the Ultra4 4600 Class, earning first, second, and third-place finishes against four-link and V8-powered competitors. That competition history continues to drive product development today.

The business designs and manufactures off-road suspension and steering systems for Ford F-Series and Bronco (1980–1997), Toyota, Chevrolet, Suzuki, and Dodge platforms. Core processes include CNC machining of 6061-T6 aluminum rotor hats and other components, welding of weld-in bungs and brackets, and assembly of kits that combine Timken unit bearings, alloy hardware, and custom-fabricated brackets. The product line spans leaf-spring kits, coil-over conversion kits, four-link kits, crossover steering conversions, brake kits, motor mounts, and a range of small hardware items.

Customers are primarily off-road enthusiasts and racers building or upgrading vehicles for trail, desert, and competitive use.

The operation was born from a desire to prove parts on the race course before offering them to the public. Sky states that every design is "continually tweaked to perfection through rigorous miles of trail and desert racing," a philosophy that ties product validation directly to competition results.

name: Skydrop Energy
old_description: At Skydrop Energy, we’ve been a trusted solar provider in Springfield, IL, since 2018, helping homes, businesses, and farms switch to renewable energy. Our solar solutions reduce costs and environmental impact with expert installation and maintenance.
about:
Skydrop Energy, based in Athens, Illinois, has been providing solar installation services across Central Illinois since 2018. The company was established to help homeowners, businesses, and farms transition to renewable energy, with a focus on reducing energy costs and environmental impact.

The company specializes in turnkey solar solutions, handling every step from educational consultation and custom system design through permitting, installation, and final system activation. Its installation teams work on residential rooftops, commercial buildings such as offices, warehouses, and retail stores, and agricultural properties including farms, ranches, and greenhouses, offering both roof-mounted and ground-mounted arrays.

Skydrop serves a mix of residential, commercial, and agricultural customers throughout Central Illinois. Residential clients include homeowners seeking to lower electricity bills and increase property value. Commercial clients range from office parks to warehouses and retail outlets. Agricultural clients encompass farms, ranches, and greenhouse operations looking to cut operational costs.

The company distinguishes itself with a free initial estimate and a hassle-free process that includes handling all permitting paperwork. It emphasizes expert installation by qualified electricians and ongoing maintenance support, aiming to deliver reliable, American-made panel systems backed by long-term warranties.
